title: Vending site readiness checklist for property managers
excerpt: Use a joint site walk to verify placement, access, utilities and responsibilities before a vending machine arrives.
opening: Do the site walk with the people who manage the building and the operator who will refill the machine. A position that looks right on a floor plan may be difficult to reach with a trolley after hours. Put the agreed position and route in your site notes so the installation team can verify both.
checklist_title: Bring this list to the site walk
checklist: Mark the proposed position on a photo or floor plan. Review sales visibility, queue space, accessibility and adjacent doors.
Walk the route from unloading point to final position. Record door, lift and corridor dimensions, turns and lift booking requirements.
Ask facilities to review the required electrical supply, connectivity, ventilation and equipment clearances against the chosen model.
Confirm operating hours, service access, security contacts and the escalation route for refunds, faults or spills.
Agree who pays for electricity, who cleans around the machine, who handles repairs and who is responsible for moving it at the end of the agreement.
Set a review date and decide what to review. Include complaints, reliability, refill visits and whether the service meets occupant needs.
close: Share photos, measurements, opening hours and the facilities contact with the operator. Record outstanding approvals before confirming installation.
